detail: Gaps — what this site needs to exist: 1. Build: R6 SHIP in tools/manifest_rules.py-land — the gate evaluator with the searcher's absence codes (no-manifest, no-dimensions, field-rejected) and the clearance action. 2. Manifest extension: a certified_by field — which copy of the standard cleared this crate. 3. Forfeiture: the walk from failure to yard-stock is a prop-store ledger event at both ends. 4. Asset-demand: the counter, the beam, the chest of nested weights, the searcher's strike-tool, the stamp — all to be born qualified. 5. Glossary watch: customs is a proper-noun-adjacent common word.
note: The gaps list what the customs house needs to become a fully playable site. R6 SHIP is the gate evaluator; the certified_by field tracks the chain of copies.
